examples.en: The wizened, old sorcerer took me under his wing and taught me everything he knew about magic.
examples.author: darinmex

defEn: To endeavor to gain someone's affection or support.
Often of a man, to try to persuade (someone) to be in an amorous relationship with.

examples.en: Wow! The pilaf at this restaurant is really good!
examples.author: FeuDRenais2
examples.tr: Vaov! Bu restorandaki pilav gerçekten iyi!

examples.en: Wow! You've lost weight. Are you on a diet?
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Vaov! Sen kilo vermişsin. Sen diyette misin?

examples.en: Oh wow! What's this, you're having lunch without me!
examples.author: bonney12
examples.tr: Vay canına! Bu nedir, bensiz öğle yemeği yiyorsun!

defEn: Covered with trees.
Aged in wooden casks.

examples.en: William lived in a lightly wooded area.
examples.author: Amastan
examples.tr: William hafif ormanlık bir alanda yaşıyordu.

examples.en: This is a heavily wooded area.
examples.author: Amastan
examples.tr: Bu, yoğun ormanlık bir alandır.

examples.en: Our village in Algeria is surrounded by a very heavily wooded area.
examples.author: Amastan
examples.tr: Cezayir'deki köyümüz çok yoğun ormanlık bir alanla çevrilidir.

defEn: To convince or influence (someone) by arguing or contending.
Followed by out of: to elicit (something) from a person by arguing or bargaining.

examples.en: The two scholars wrangled over the meaning of an obscure Tibetan phrase.
examples.author: darinmex
examples.tr: İki bilim adamı bilinmeyen bir Tibet ifadesinin anlamı üzerinde tartıştı.

examples.en: We are involved in a legal wrangle over payments.
examples.author: marco87

examples.en: This contract dispute turned into a legal wrangle.
examples.author: rul

defEn: To pull or twist violently.
To injure (a joint) by pulling or twisting.

examples.en: Tom came in with a wrench in his hand.
examples.author: CK
examples.tr: Tom elinde bir İngiliz anahtarıyla içeri geldi.

examples.en: He wrenched the letter from my hand.
examples.author: mamat
examples.tr: O, mektubu elimden zorla aldı.

examples.en: A wrench is a commonly used tool.
examples.author: Source_VOA
examples.tr: Bir İngiliz anahtarı, yaygın olarak kullanılan bir araçtır.

defEn: Turned away, contorted (of the face or body).
Dryly humorous; sardonic or ironic, usually in a way that suggests acknowledgement of a problem or difficult situation.

examples.en: Mary looks to you with a wry, respectful smile.
examples.author: corvard

examples.en: Your wry insolence will not be rewarded.
examples.author: nonong

examples.en: His interjection prompts wry laughs and nervousness.
examples.author: Cangarejo

defEn: In a wry or sarcastic manner; ironically.
Of a facial expression, contortedly.

examples.en: Rachel smiled wryly at Bryan, clearly showing her discomfort after being dragged into an unwanted interaction with him.

defEn: Unusual and awkward in a funny, comical manner; outlandish; clownish.
Ludicrously or incongruously comical.

examples.en: He always had a zany sense of humor.
examples.author: AlanF_US

examples.en: The otherwise dark and serious comic is punctuated by pages of zany side stories.
examples.author: Auride
